description: Add food to inventory. Required: food_id, unit_id, amount (> 0), location_id. Optional: expires (YYYY-MM-DD), sub_location, note, code. Always creates a new entry, even when the same food already has an entry at that location.

code.description: Short label, up to 16 characters. Default: the entry ID in hex.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

sub_location.description: Spot within the location, such as a shelf.

name: add_inventory_item
title: Add inventory item
